{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Correct the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders (if any) — though we saw 0
sales = sales[sales['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Filter out refunded orders since they don't contribute to revenue
sales = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Now compute total revenue per channel
channel_revenue = sales.groupby('channel', observed=True)['revenue'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)

# Display results
print(channel_revenue)"}
